C1289.title: 13 Payment Institutions Fined RMB 212 Million in 2025, Helibao Tops with 75 Million Penalty
C1289.summary: In 2025, the People's Bank of China and its local branches maintained intense regulatory pressure on non-bank payment institutions, imposing fines totaling RMB 212 million on 13 entities. Five firms—Helibao Payment, Huiyuan Yintong, Zhongtong Payment, Yakoo Space-Time, and Huiju Payment—were penalized over RMB 10 million each, collectively exceeding RMB 143 million.
